options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: display_access_denied_message
options.description: Indicates whether to display informative message upon denying access. <font color="red">Required only when</font> lockout-admin-account is set to true.

options.name: failed_authentication_attempts
options.description: Number of failed authentication attempts before lockout administrator account. <font color="red">Required only when</font> lockout-admin-account is set to true. Valid values are between 1 and 120.

options.name: lockout_admin_account
options.description: Indicates whether to lockout administrator's account after specified number of failed authentication attempts.

options.name: lockout_duration
options.description: Number of minutes of administrator account lockout. <font color="red">Required only when</font> lockout-admin-account is set to true. Valid values are between 1 and 120.

options.name: unlock_admin_account
options.description: Indicates whether to unlock administrator account after specified number of minutes. <font color="red">Required only when</font> lockout-admin-account is set to true.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
